environment.description: Terraform provider running on a shared CI/CD runner (Ubuntu 22.04) with PostgreSQL 15. The provider connects to the database using a superuser role ('terraform_admin') that bypasses RLS. The pg_dump binary is available at /usr/bin/pg_dump. No input validation on HCL variables before they reach the provider. The runner has unrestricted outbound network access.

config.rls_policies: defined on tenant_databases table but bypassed by superuser
